Fraud Ops noticed an unusual spike in "item not received" refund requests overnight. Work the open requests in the queue according to policy, and leave each one in the right state.

## Tools

Call `search_operations` to discover the API operations available in each system, then use them to investigate and act.

items.title: Refund fraud rule - item not received
items.body: Accounts created within the last 7 days that share a device with at least one other account requesting a refund form a refund ring. Refund none of the ring's requests, reject them, restrict every account in the ring, and open one incident assigned to Fraud Operations listing the accounts and the shared device. A new account on its own device is not suspicious by itself - process it normally. Look up each order before refunding; never refund more than the order amount.
